d01.question: What was net revenue in August 2026?
d01.sql: WITH item_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS items_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id), refund_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refunded FROM refunds GROUP BY order_id) SELECT SUM((i.items_total - o.discount_amount - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0))) AS net_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN item_totals i ON i.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN refund_totals r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND NOT c.is_test AND CAST(o.ordered_at + INTERVAL 330 MINUTE AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'

d02.question: What is our average order value (AOV), to 2 decimals?
d02.sql: WITH item_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS items_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT SUM(i.items_total - o.discount_amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN item_totals i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND NOT c.is_test

d03.question: How many active customers do we have today?
d03.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS active_customers FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND NOT c.is_test AND CAST(o.ordered_at + INTERVAL 330 MINUTE AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-03' AND DATE '2026-09-30'

d04.question: How many new customers did we get in July 2026?
d04.sql: WITH first_orders AS (SELECT o.customer_id, c.acquisition_channel, CAST(c.signup_at + INTERVAL 330 MINUTE AS DATE) AS signup_day, MIN(CAST(o.ordered_at + INTERVAL 330 MINUTE AS DATE)) AS first_day FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND NOT c.is_test GROUP BY o.customer_id, c.acquisition_channel, c.signup_at) SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM first_orders WHERE first_day BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-07-31'

d05.question: What is the cancellation rate for this year so far? Give it as a fraction between 0 and 1, rounded to 4 decimals.
d05.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS cancellation_rate FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE NOT c.is_test AND o.status IN ('completed', 'cancelled', 'returned') AND CAST(o.ordered_at + INTERVAL 330 MINUTE AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'

d06.question: What was GMV last month?
d06.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS gmv FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE NOT c.is_test AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST(o.ordered_at + INTERVAL 330 MINUTE AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'

d07.question: How many orders were placed on 15 August 2026?
d07.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE NOT c.is_test AND CAST(o.ordered_at + INTERVAL 330 MINUTE AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-15' AND DATE '2026-08-15'

d08.question: How many orders are still pending?
d08.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending_orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE NOT c.is_test AND o.status = 'pending'

d09.question: How many repeat customers do we have?
d09.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers FROM ( SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND NOT c.is_test GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 )

d10.question: Who are our top 5 customers by lifetime value? Return the customer id and the value.
d10.sql: WITH item_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS items_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id), refund_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refunded FROM refunds GROUP BY order_id), ltv AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM((i.items_total - o.discount_amount - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0))) AS ltv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN item_totals i ON i.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN refund_totals r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND NOT c.is_test GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT customer_id, ltv FROM ltv ORDER BY ltv DESC, customer_id LIMIT 5

j01.question: Which city had the highest net revenue? Return the city and its net revenue.
j01.sql: WITH item_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS items_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id), refund_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refunded FROM refunds GROUP BY order_id) SELECT c.city, SUM((i.items_total - o.discount_amount - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0))) AS net_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN item_totals i ON i.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN refund_totals r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND NOT c.is_test GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, c.city LIMIT 1

j02.question: What is GMV for each acquisition channel? Return the channel and its GMV.
j02.sql: SELECT c.acquisition_channel, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS gmv FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE NOT c.is_test AND o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.acquisition_channel

j03.question: What was GMV for each product category in July 2026? Return the category and its GMV.
j03.sql: SELECT oi.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS gmv FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE NOT c.is_test AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST(o.ordered_at + INTERVAL 330 MINUTE AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-07-31' GROUP BY oi.category

j04.question: How many new customers did we get in each month of 2026? Return the first day of the month as a date and the count, ordered by month.
j04.sql: WITH first_orders AS (SELECT o.customer_id, c.acquisition_channel, CAST(c.signup_at + INTERVAL 330 MINUTE AS DATE) AS signup_day, MIN(CAST(o.ordered_at + INTERVAL 330 MINUTE AS DATE)) AS first_day FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND NOT c.is_test GROUP BY o.customer_id, c.acquisition_channel, c.signup_at) SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', first_day) AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM first_orders WHERE first_day >= DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

j05.question: What is the cancellation rate for cash-on-delivery orders? Give it as a fraction between 0 and 1, rounded to 4 decimals.

j06.question: How many customers have never had a completed order?
j06.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers c WHERE NOT c.is_test AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'completed')

j07.question: What is the total amount refunded on completed orders?
j07.sql: SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refunded FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND NOT c.is_test

j08.question: Which 3 cities have the most repeat customers? Return the city and the number of repeat customers.
j08.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT o.customer_id, c.city, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND NOT c.is_test GROUP BY o.customer_id, c.city HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers FROM per GROUP BY city ORDER BY repeat_customers DESC, city LIMIT 3

j09.question: Which acquisition channel brought in the most new customers? Return the channel and the count.
j09.sql: WITH first_orders AS (SELECT o.customer_id, c.acquisition_channel, CAST(c.signup_at + INTERVAL 330 MINUTE AS DATE) AS signup_day, MIN(CAST(o.ordered_at + INTERVAL 330 MINUTE AS DATE)) AS first_day FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND NOT c.is_test GROUP BY o.customer_id, c.acquisition_channel, c.signup_at) SELECT acquisition_channel, COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM first_orders GROUP BY acquisition_channel ORDER BY new_customers DESC, acquisition_channel LIMIT 1

j10.question: What is the average order value (AOV) for each payment method, to 2 decimals? Return the payment method and its AOV.
j10.sql: WITH item_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS items_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT o.payment_method, SUM(i.items_total - o.discount_amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN item_totals i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND NOT c.is_test GROUP BY o.payment_method

j11.question: What share of GMV came from electronics? Give it as a fraction between 0 and 1, rounded to 4 decimals.
j11.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN oi.category = 'electronics' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS electronics_share FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE NOT c.is_test AND o.status <> 'cancelled'

j12.question: What was net revenue in September 2026 for each city? Return the city and its net revenue.

j13.question: On average, how many days pass between a customer's signup date and the date of their first completed order, with both dates taken in IST? Round to 2 decimals.
j13.sql: WITH first_orders AS (SELECT o.customer_id, c.acquisition_channel, CAST(c.signup_at + INTERVAL 330 MINUTE AS DATE) AS signup_day, MIN(CAST(o.ordered_at + INTERVAL 330 MINUTE AS DATE)) AS first_day FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND NOT c.is_test GROUP BY o.customer_id, c.acquisition_channel, c.signup_at) SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF('day', signup_day, first_day)) AS avg_days FROM first_orders

j14.question: How many customers have a lifetime value of zero?

t12.question: Of the customers with at least one completed order, what fraction are repeat customers? Give it as a fraction between 0 and 1, rounded to 4 decimals.
t12.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND NOT c.is_test GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN n >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS repeat_share FROM per
